explanation: Count values by their upper 16 bits, select a bucket with fewer than 2^16 entries, and scan the input again to mark that bucket’s lower-bit combinations. Return an unmarked combination from that bucket.
timeComplexity: O(n + 2^16) time over two input passes.
spaceComplexity: O(2^16) counters and presence bits, fixed for 32-bit inputs.
